title: Triage hello@ and the MMH inbox
instructions:
1. Open hello@receptionmate.co.uk and the MMH inbox.
2. Reply to customer/garage questions you can answer; escalate anything you can't to Dan.
3. Forward genuine SALES enquiries straight to Dan — don't sit on them.
4. Archive/label handled threads so the inbox stays clean.

title: Routine admin — diary, follow-ups, invoices
instructions:
1. Check the diary/calendar and note any follow-ups due today.
2. Log any invoices or receipts that came in.
3. Chase anything left outstanding from yesterday.

title: Social comments, DMs & scheduled post
instructions:
1. Check comments + DMs on the ReceptionMate and MMH Facebook/Instagram accounts.
2. Reply to genuine questions; flag any leads to Dan.
3. Publish the day's scheduled post if one is queued.
(Events/festival & seasonal content posts itself — don't touch it.)

title: Confirm every voice agent is online
instructions:
1. Check the agent-watchdog alerts (email/SMS) for any overnight outage.
2. Run `lk agent list` and confirm each agent is deployed/available.
3. If a garage looks down, check its recent call logs in the portal AND its routing (agentScript/agentType); action or escalate immediately — a silent outage loses live calls.

title: Work the negative-call feedback
instructions:
1. In the portal, filter calls to NEGATIVE (👎) feedback since yesterday.
2. Listen to the actual recording for each — don't guess the cause.
3. Fix where it's a fixable pattern (FAQ / rule / KB / prompt).
4. Log each one in the feedback sheet: garage, call ID, cause, fix applied, status.

title: Skim reg-capture (VRM) failures
instructions:
1. In the call logs, skim the registration-capture failures from the last day.
2. Look for a NEW pattern (a specific letter/number mishearing, a garage-specific plate format).
3. If it repeats, note it for the reg-normaliser; one-offs just log.

title: Messaging inbox & human-handoff flags
instructions:
1. Open the Messaging (Connect) inbox.
2. Action any human-handoff flags — a customer waiting on a person.
3. Reply, or route to the garage as needed.

title: Move new signups along
instructions:
1. Open the HighLevel onboarding pipeline.
2. Move each new signup to its correct stage.
3. Once a garage's agent is built, send the welcome email with login details.

title: Answer in-portal support tickets
instructions:
1. Open the in-portal support inbox (/admin/support).
2. Reply to any threads Leah escalated (status awaiting_staff).
3. Close out resolved ones.

title: Confirm the 9am MMH reminders ran
instructions:
1. On the EC2 box, check mmh-docs-reminders.log for today's 9am run.
2. Confirm it ran and shows the document texts sent (0 due is fine).
3. If the log is missing or shows errors, the cron failed — investigate/escalate: customers won't have got their upload links.

title: Answer MMH hire messages
instructions:
1. Check inbound MMH hire messages (chat/SMS).
2. Answer anything needing a human.
3. Nudge enquiries toward a booking — offer the nearest available dates.

title: Weekly admin sweep + summary to Dan
instructions:
1. Reconcile the week's invoices/receipts + expenses; chase anything outstanding.
2. Write Dan a SHORT weekly summary: what happened + what needs his sales attention.
3. Send it.

title: Plan & schedule the week's social
instructions:
1. Plan the coming week's Facebook/social posts for both brands.
2. Schedule them.
3. Review last week's engagement and note what worked.

title: Check Google Ads conversion tracking
instructions:
1. Open Google Ads.
2. Confirm conversion tracking + enhanced conversions are firing (recent conversions are recording).
3. Flag any drop to Dan.

title: Call-quality review (sample per garage)
instructions:
1. Sample a handful of calls per garage from this week.
2. Check booking conversion, reg capture, and response gaps.
3. Note any garage trending worse and dig in.

title: Agent-error QA (accuracy sample)
instructions:
1. Pull a weekly sample of calls per garage.
2. Check for accuracy problems: wrong prices/hours, made-up facts, ghost or wrong-date bookings, missed/failed transfers.
3. Flag anything customer-facing to Dan and fix at source (KB / rule / prompt).

title: Is every garage still forwarding its calls?
instructions:
1. In the call logs, check each garage's call volume for the week.
2. Flag any garage that's suddenly dropped to ~0 calls — it may have stopped forwarding (gets zero AI calls and blames us silently).
3. For a quiet garage, cross-check its routing too, then contact them.

title: Billing hygiene
instructions:
1. Review arrears + failed Stripe payments.
2. Chase users without a mandate (the users-without-mandate list).
3. Note upcoming trial expiries.

title: Verify deploys & config syncs landed
instructions:
1. Confirm the week's agent deploys (CI/CD) actually landed (`lk agent versions`).
2. Confirm config syncs (Postgres → DynamoDB) applied.
3. Flag any drift.

title: Proactive check-ins
instructions:
1. New garages: do the week-1 and week-4 touchpoint.
2. Established garages: send the light MONTHLY value check-in (their stats + 'anything you need?') to any due this week.
3. Reach out immediately to any garage the data flags — usage drop, negative-feedback trend, or a failed payment.

title: MMH weekly review
instructions:
1. Review the week's MMH bookings + document-completion rate.
2. Chase anyone outstanding.
3. Mine chat/voice transcripts for missed questions → add new FAQs.

title: Full VRM-capture analysis
instructions:
1. Pull the reg-STT logs across all agents for the month.
2. Measure the capture rate.
3. Ship any flag-gated normaliser fixes and re-measure.

title: Per-garage performance review
instructions:
1. For each garage, pull latency trends, booking conversion, cost/call (session usage), model behaviour.
2. Note the winners and the laggards.
3. Action or flag to Dan.

title: KB / FAQ audit per garage
instructions:
1. For each garage, compare its KB/FAQs against the month's calls.
2. Fill gaps — questions the agent couldn't answer.
3. Retire stale entries.

title: Reconcile manual-pay invoices
instructions:
1. The In'n'out combined invoice auto-emails on the 1st — DON'T raise it.
2. Check the bank for In'n'out + any other bank-transfer garages' payments.
3. Mark those invoices as paid in the system.

title: Full billing reconciliation
instructions:
1. Reconcile arrears, mandates, invoices and refunds for the month.
2. Resolve any mismatches.

title: Content calendar + refresh demos
instructions:
1. Build next month's social content calendar.
2. Review the month's reach/engagement.
3. Refresh the sales demos (/demo, /lkqdemo, /partsdemo).

title: App build / push-notification check
instructions:
1. If there were app changes, ship a build / TestFlight upload.
2. Send a test push and confirm notifications still work end-to-end.

title: Security & hygiene
instructions:
1. Rotate the Facebook token.
2. Review the box-vs-git drift.
3. Confirm backups + config-sync health.

title: Support hub — read first (goal & rules)
instructions: The portal support inbox becomes the ONE place all support lands (email, WhatsApp, calls). Rules: (1) keep hello@ as the single address — AI sorts billing/support/sales AFTER arrival, no new mailboxes; (2) NOT HighLevel's inbox — it lives in our portal; (3) ship the phases below, don't stop agent work.

title: Support hub · Phase 0 — audit what's live
instructions:
1. On the EC2 branch, check: can a customer clearly find 'Support' in the portal?
2. Does the admin inbox (app/admin/support) load and show threads?
3. Does an escalation actually email the team, and does someone watch it?
Done when: a short note says exactly what exists vs. missing.

title: Support hub · Phase 1 — email into the portal
instructions:
1. Add a Mailgun inbound route on hello@ → webhook.
2. AI (Leah) tags each email billing/support/sales/other and creates/updates a ticket.
3. AI DRAFTS a reply for a human to approve — it does NOT auto-send; never auto-reply to no-reply/bulk senders.
4. Staff reply sends from hello@ with a [RM #id] subject token so replies thread back.
Done when: an email to hello@ becomes a tagged ticket with a draft reply, an approved reply round-trips, and no new address was created.

title: Support hub · Phase 1b — noise filter
instructions:
1. Spam → drop/quarantine on the Mailgun score; no ticket, NEVER unsubscribe.
2. Marketing/bulk → detect List-Unsubscribe and auto-unsubscribe (one-click), with a first-time confirm per sender.
3. Transactional (Stripe/GoCardless/Twilio/suppliers) → NEVER unsubscribe; route to billing/ops.
Done when: spam creates no tickets, marketing can be unsubscribed in one click, transactional is kept and routed.

title: Support hub · Phase 2 — real shared inbox
instructions:
1. Let a ticket belong to a CONTACT (email/phone), not just a logged-in user; allow >1 per contact.
2. Add assignee, internal staff-only notes, and filter views by category + status.
Done when: the team works one inbox, sorted by tag, each ticket owned by a named person.

title: Support hub · Phase 3 — WhatsApp into the portal
instructions:
1. Point a BUSINESS WhatsApp number (never personal) at the Meta webhook → ticket (channel: whatsapp) keyed to the sender's number.
2. Staff reply goes back via the WhatsApp API.
Done when: a WhatsApp message shows as a ticket and a reply reaches the customer on WhatsApp.

title: Support hub · Phase 4 — calls into the portal
instructions:
1. Point a support phone number at a ReceptionMate agent.
2. On call end, log the transcript + summary as a ticket (channel: phone).
Done when: a support call becomes a ticket with its summary, and Dan's mobile is no longer the support line.

title: Support hub · make it findable & tell customers
instructions:
1. Make 'Support' prominent in the portal.
2. Message existing + new customers with the one official way to reach us.
Done when: every customer knows the portal / official channels are THE way to get help.

title: Fix the observability dashboard
instructions:
1. The dashboard reads dead metric keys (avg_llm_latency_ms) the current agents no longer emit.
2. Repoint it at the live keys the agents write now (e.g. metrics.latency.response_gap_p50_s).
3. Verify the tiles populate.

title: max_delay endpointing A/B
instructions:
1. On ONE non-learning garage, A/B a lower endpointing max_delay.
2. Measure the reply-gap vs reg-capture trade-off.
3. Roll out only if it's a clear win.

title: Manual voice-agent deploy for MMH
instructions:
1. MMH's CI auto-deploy is DISABLED (separate new-gh-agent LiveKit project).
2. Deploy the MMH agent manually when its code changes.
3. Confirm live via a test dispatch.

title: Put the MMH project under git
instructions:
1. Init git for the MMH site + mmh-api.
2. gitignore: .env, mmh-docs/ (customer PII), the SQLite DB, and venv.
3. Commit; deploy from the EC2 source (local is out of sync).

title: ICO data-protection registration (MMH)
instructions:
1. Register Midlands Motorhome Hire with the ICO for data protection.
2. Keep the confirmation on file.

title: Onboard new garages end-to-end
instructions:
1. GarageHive connect (paste the instance; branches auto-match).
2. Wire WhatsApp/Connect if bought.
3. Upload the KB + FAQs.
4. Build the agent, then send the welcome email.

title: Update the MMH hire agreement & T&Cs
instructions:
1. Update the hire agreement + T&Cs in Wheelbase / Outdoorsy to the current terms.
2. Make sure each includes an e-signature field at the bottom.
3. Prep them ready — DAN sends the new agreements out.

title: Build the in-portal Tasks board
instructions:
1. Build from ops-tasks-board-spec.md: OpsTask model + /admin/tasks page.
2. Per-task instructions, notes, assignment between Dan & the VA, add-task, status — Postgres-backed so it's shared.
3. Seed it from this file (ops-tasks-seed.json).
